VBM.classification: nearest atomic center in periodic cartesian distance, assigned by component; no chemical partition
VBM.caveats: approximate real-space Voronoi partition of pseudo-state density, individual k/band; grid subsampling and choice of boundary affect quantitative fractions; not excited electron/hole
